cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

mechanism: A trains a helper in supposedly proper care of an unusual participant until the strange interaction becomes a shared routine.
confusable: Practical grounding alone need not recruit participation; D145 requires B to join the strange behavior.
comparison: Change the dinner setting to workplace hospitality so the alternatives do not both rehearse guest seating.
seedUse: Retain the cupboard's practical accommodation idea, transform it into a staff greeting ritual with corrections responding to B.
